split.title: Lana Is Living Money
split.body:
Lana is living money — and everything that is alive exists in flow.

Lana mirrors the natural process of mitosis, where life doubles with every division. In a similar way, during each Split, the funds also double. This process gives Lana the growth, movement, and speed it needs in order to truly live as money.

But everything that exists in flow must also remain in balance.

Just think of a bicycle. A bicycle can move forward only when it stays in balance. The same is true for a car, where we need both the accelerator and the brake. The same is true for breathing, where inhale and exhale move together in rhythm. In truth, all of life is based on this rhythm — the movement between expansion and balance.

The same applies to the wallets of your regular customers.

During a Split, your regular customers will be able to celebrate, because their funds will double. Yes, you heard that correctly. If a customer has 33 euros in their wallet today, they will have 66 euros after the Split. You can see this as the accelerator in a car — the force that gives the system life, growth, and movement.

But for the system to remain stable, it also needs a brake.

If your customer exceeds 100 euros after the Split, those funds will first be used to enter Lana8Wonder. If there are still additional funds left, the surplus will be donated to the common good. This is not a punishment, but a natural balancing mechanism that keeps the whole wheel stable.

For some people, this way of thinking may feel unfamiliar at first, because we are used to operating within a linear economy — an economy that is rigid, closed, and therefore often unable to return abundance back into life.

The Economy of Abundance works differently.

The Economy of Abundance lives in flow. That is why it needs growth, movement, circulation, and balance. And within this balance, Lana can become living money — money that does not stand still, but circulates; money that does not accumulate, but supports; money that does not drain life, but returns it back to the community.
principles.title: Lana Participation & Responsibility Principles
principles.subtitle: Welcome to the Lana ecosystem. Lana is built on trust, transparency, and shared responsibility. This document sets out the principles and process that keep the ecosystem fair for everyone.
principles.s1Intro: Lana is more than a transaction system. It is a relationship-based ecosystem where value, trust, and accountability move together. By joining, you agree to uphold:
principles.s2Intro: All activity recorded through Lana must reflect real and truthful exchange. This includes:
principles.s2P4: Truthful reporting of products and services
principles.s2N5: Use of the system for personal gain outside agreed principles
principles.s3Intro: We recognise that mistakes, misunderstandings, and misuse may occur. If an issue is identified, the first step is always:
principles.s3Action: Where needed, participants may be asked to:
principles.s3Responsibility: This is part of Lana's principle of unconditional self-responsibility. Each participant remains free in their choices, and equally responsible for the consequences of those choices.
principles.s4Intro: If a serious issue is identified and responsibility is not yet taken, access to the Lana ecosystem may be temporarily suspended until the matter is resolved. This may include temporary suspension of:
principles.s4P4: Participation within the Lana shop and related services
principles.s4Restore: Access is restored once the matter has been addressed through the responsibility and correction process. Our focus is always restoration before exclusion.
principles.s4Repeated: Repeated or deliberate misuse may lead to permanent removal from the ecosystem.
principles.core: Freedom includes full ownership of consequences. Lana grows through trust. Trust grows through truth.
principles.closing: Thank you for being part of a living economy built on responsibility and mutual respect.
